Peace of Mind.

## Hyperping Story

No established internet business ever wants downtime. 

The least they want is - if there’s ever a downtime of their website or product, then they should be notified ASAP. 

That’s what Hypering does. It solves a business critical pain. 

When you think of your next idea - think if it is a painkiller for an existing business?

I dove deeper to see how Leo, the founder of Hyperping got started on this journey. 

## Hyperping Top Lessons

- He’s been at it for more than 5 years.
- Took him 9 months to get to $500 MRR.
- Product Hunt launch was a powerful lever in early success.
- External accountability was a major help in get him to actually ship the product.

## The full story

Ali Salah built Instatus, a service for creating status pages. Reaching $1K MRR was his goal for 2020.

### Product-Market Fit

Initially offered a free forever plan, no one would upgrade. Now some customers upgrade within a day.

### Customer Support

His initial tendency was to fix issues first, then reply. He evolved to over-communication: send emails proactively.

- Time to $1K MRR: 1 year
- Early churn: High, now very low
- Channel: SEO

### Key Takeaways

1

Don't invest heavily in marketing until product-market fit is proven

2

Over-communicate with customers - reply fast even if just to acknowledge

3

Early churn is normal - focus on improving the product based on feedback

4

Freemium can work but requires patience before users upgrade
